as_told.title: Buzz Aldrin refuses James Fox interview

plain: The filmmaker James Fox says he chased the astronaut Buzz Aldrin around the world for an on-camera interview about UFOs, finally got him to Monte Carlo, and then Aldrin told him at the last minute, "I'm not doing the interview." Fox tells it on the show more than once as something he lived through, placing it in the late 1990s at the Monte Carlo Hotel and crediting Paul Allen with a part in setting it up, while Michels, retelling it, puts it in the 2000s and adds Aldrin's line, "What would my testimony do anyways?" If it is true, a moonwalker came close to speaking on the subject and then pulled back.
